reconDefinitions.reposWithUppercaseInRepositoryName: distinct (owner, repo) pairs whose repository name contains uppercase letters; 216, not 225.
reconDefinitions.urlsWithTreeSubpath: the actual count is 597, not the brief's 285; 289 of those have no npm identity and 281 point at .../packages/*.

reconDefinitions.duplicateBasenames_caseSensitive_allEntr: distinct repository basenames compared case-sensitively, claimed by >1 owner, all entries: 283.
reconDefinitions.entriesWithNpmIdentity: entries carrying a usable upstream `npm` package name: 2607. These convert with no network call.
